lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Kuda?! You made it back... but you have legs?!

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: Yeah, I noticed. Had to drag myself out of the water after that fight, and suddenly—this.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: I was worried you were still down there. Don't pull that on me again.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You need somewhere to rest. Come on, I'll show you the townhouse.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: Hmph. Fine. But I'm walking there on my own.
